I am an old man now, 84 years, but I still farm my small piece of land here in Mangochi with help from my household. This season I have my FISP coupon, praise God, so I will use the NPK and urea on my maize — I spread it a bit thin across my plots but it helps. I plant the hybrid seed from the coupon, and I put some manure from the goats where the soil is tired. My body cannot do everything, so my children help me, and I pay a young man a few days of ganyu for the hard digging and weeding.
